reviewProvenance.manualVisualComparison: The source figure wears black off-shoulder kimono with large red/white patterned sleeves, holds a pink folding fan and stands on a black oval base with lantern and petals. Canonical Nico Robin cover shows blue sleeveless crop top, long pink trousers and a green foliage/rock base. Outfits, pose, hand props and pedestal do not match; all seven source views corroborate the distinct sculpture. Search other One Piece historical variants; a single different cover cannot prove absence.
